title: TERRA — The 20 Primals as a Living Ecology
premise: Each primal is a species. The codebase is the biome. We can SEE them as an ecology ON Gaia — a simulation of TERRA.

barraCuda.niche: ACCELERATION — CUDA/GPU compute, parallel processing predator
barraCuda.ecology: apex predator of the compute reef, hunts in parallel

bearDog.niche: CRYPTOGRAPHY — zero-trust signing, HSM integration, the pack guardian
bearDog.ecology: alpha predator of the identity forest, guards territory with Ed25519 teeth

bingoCube.niche: COMMITMENT — human-verifiable crypto, the trust ritual
bingoCube.ecology: scarab that rolls commitments — small but sacred

biomeOS.niche: OPERATING SYSTEM — the substrate everything grows in
biomeOS.ecology: not a species — the SOIL ITSELF. Everything roots into biomeOS.

cellMembrane.niche: BOUNDARY — Caddy reverse proxy, TLS, the skin
cellMembrane.ecology: the membrane between SELF and WORLD. Selective permeability.

coralReef.ecology: builds visible structures from invisible code. The reef others live ON.

esotericWebb.niche: GAME ENGINE — CRPG, 28 capabilities, the web of play
esotericWebb.ecology: spins webs of narrative. 484 tests. Catches stories.

loamSpine.ecology: moves through soil, leaves tunnels. The tunnels ARE the chain.

nestGate.ecology: the structure everything builds INSIDE. Rooms and tunnels.

petalTongue.ecology: pollinates by displaying — sees UV, speaks in color gradients

rhizoCrypt.niche: EPHEMERAL MEMORY — DAG engine, working memory that dissolves
rhizoCrypt.ecology: underground fungal network. Messages pass then decompose.

skunkBat.niche: DEFENSE — network security, 9 threat types, graduated response
skunkBat.ecology: nocturnal defender. Sprays threats (skunk). Echolocates anomalies (bat). 673 tests.

songBird.niche: COMMUNICATION — mesh protocol, network orchestration, discovery
songBird.ecology: sings to coordinate. Dawn chorus = network discovery. Territory song = routing.

sourDough.ecology: symbiotic culture. Bacteria + yeast. Feed it flour, it gives you bread.

squirrel.niche: SENSING — MCP agent, the one who notices everything
squirrel.ecology: buries nuts (caches), finds them later. Chatters warnings. 360° awareness.

swarmVine.ecology: grows over everything. Gossip protocol = vine tendrils. 186 tests.
swarmVine.role: Epidemic gossip engine for mesh propagation

sweetGrass.niche: PROVENANCE — semantic attribution, who made what
sweetGrass.ecology: braided grass. Each braid = a provenance chain. Sacred.

toadStool.ecology: fruiting body of the mycelium. Computes emerge like mushrooms.

wateringHole.niche: GUIDANCE — ecosystem governance, where all species gather
wateringHole.ecology: the place where predators and prey drink together. Neutral ground.

amoeba.niche: CONNECTION — remote access, the pseudopod that reaches anywhere
amoeba.ecology: simplest free-living organism. Extends pseudopods (connections) in any direction. Absorbs what it touches. Given freely.

amoeba_needs.swarmVine: gossip mesh for relay discovery — vine tendrils find peers
amoeba_needs.skunkBat: defense layer — 9 threat types protect every connection
amoeba_needs.songBird: network orchestration — the relay protocol itself
amoeba_needs.bearDog: ZK signing — every session Ed25519 signed
amoeba_needs.bingoCube: ZK auth — commitment scheme for identity
amoeba_needs.squirrel: AI agent — the MCP built into the remote session
amoeba_needs.loamSpine: audit chain — every session on the spine

symbiosis.wifi_test_failure_means: Every Wi-Fi device on a LAN is an AMOEBA client. The 'failure' is the MOST COMMON use case. swarmVine + skunkBat + songBird = the Wi-Fi mesh that connects them all.

terra_view: 20 primals = 20 species in a simulated ecology. The codebase IS the biome. The tests ARE natural selection. The dependencies ARE the food web. Gaia IS Terra.
